summary:
Stage 4 (C5, commit a138810) reviewed at head 9fab69ae against base 98b1ffea. deckTypeAudit is correct by inspection for every C5 clause, and the 12 tests in scholar-slides/tests/deck_type.test.mjs kill most guard mutants. No blocking defect. Three minor weaknesses: the qa_report wiring test is a regex over the source text; the section-divider guard and each limitations/future-work alternative have no test, so mutants there survive; and the title regexes give false negatives on common motivation-slide titles. Corpus impact (inferred by reading out/*/deck.json, not by running anything): attention, deepseek_v32, emphasis_demo, glm5, glm5_zh and xlstm (journal-club) and deepseek_conf (conference) get no deck-type finding. zh_smoke (journal-club, no critique-concerns slide) gets 1 P2 missing-archetype. adv (the adversarial fixture, no meta.deck_type, so journal-club) gets 2 P2 missing-archetype. All of these are P2, so the qa_report exit code (P0=2 / P1=1) does not change for any corpus deck. run_benchmark.mjs does not call deckTypeAudit, so benchmark and qa_report finding counts now diverge further (already listed as known item M10 in IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN). references/qa-self-review.md still documents four layers and does not mention the deck-type stage.

MUTATION TARGETS (selected by: adversary, claude subagent). Line numbers are for scholar-slides/scripts/lib/qa.mjs at the head unless stated.
1. [C5 journal-club absent type] L174: change `deck.meta?.deck_type ?? "journal-club"` to `?? "conference"`. Expected KILL: test 'absent deck_type is audited as journal-club' (deck_type.test.mjs L50).
2. [C5 journal-club per-missing role] L183: drop "discussion-questions" from the layout list `["critique-concerns", "discussion-questions"]`. Expected KILL: 'journal-club: each missing critique / discussion slide is a P2 naming the layout' (L41), noDiscussion branch.
3. [C5 journal-club severity] L184: change severity "P2" to "P3" in the missing-archetype push. Expected KILL: L41 and L50 (checks() compares P2:missing-archetype).
4. [C5 journal-club guard] L184: invert `if (!has(layout))` to `if (has(layout))`. Expected KILL: 'a conforming deck of each type has no deck-type finding' (L35) and L41.
5. [C5 defense no backup] L189: delete `backup === -1 ||`. Expected KILL: 'defense: no Backup divider is a P2' (L55).
6. [C5 defense backup followed by >=1 slide, boundary] L189: delete `|| backup === slides.length - 1`, or change it to `backup === slides.length`. Expected KILL: 'defense: a Backup divider with nothing after it is a P2' (L60).
7. [C5 defense section-divider guard] L188: delete `s.layout === "section" &&` so that any slide titled Backup/Appendix counts. Expected: SURVIVES. No test has a non-section slide titled Backup/Appendix. Add one, e.g. a bullets slide titled 'Backup results' followed by one slide, which must still produce P2 missing-backup (see finding 2).
8. [C5 defense Chinese backup] L169: remove `|附录` from BACKUP_RE. Expected KILL: 'defense: Chinese 附录 divider counts as Backup' (L65).
9. [C5 defense limitations guard] L193: change `!slides.some(...)` to `slides.some(...)`. Expected KILL: L35 (DEFENSE conforming) and 'defense: no limitations / future-work slide is a P2' (L70).
10. [C5 defense limitations vocabulary] L170: replace LIMITS_RE with `/局限/`. Expected KILL: L35 (the title 'Limitations and future work' no longer matches). Removing only `\blimitations?\b`, or only `\bfuture work\b`, SURVIVES, because the single conforming title contains both phrases (see finding 2).
11. [C5 conference P3] L198: change `s.layout === "critique-concerns"` to `"discussion-questions"`, or change severity P3 to P2, or `slide: i + 1` to `slide: i`. Expected KILL: 'conference: a critique slide is a P3 on that slide' (L82).
12. [C5 branch scoping / conforming conference] L182: change `type === "journal-club"` to `type !== "defense"`, so conference decks get the journal-club rules. Expected KILL: 'conference does not demand journal-club archetypes' (L89) and L35.
13. [C5 conforming defense] L182: change `type === "journal-club"` to `type !== "conference"`. Expected KILL: L35 (DEFENSE gains 2 P2 missing-archetype).
14. [C5 unknown type P1] L175: change `!DECK_TYPES.includes(type)` to `false`. Separately, change "P1" to "P2". Separately, replace `${DECK_TYPES.join(", ")}` in the detail with a fixed string. Expected KILL for each: 'unknown deck_type is P1 naming the allowed values' (L93).
15. [C5 wiring into qa_report] scholar-slides/scripts/qa_report.mjs L59: delete the line. Expected KILL: 'qa_report wires deckTypeAudit into the CKPT-3 report' (L99). Prefix it with `if (false)`, or move it into an unreachable branch. Expected: SURVIVES, because the test only matches the source text with a regex (see finding 1).
16. [C5 docs] references/deck-types.md and SKILL.md: there is no executable check. Verify by reading that the table matches the rule set (it does at the head).

findings.title: qa_report wiring test is a source-text regex and passes with deckTypeAudit disabled
findings.what_goes_wrong: The only check for the C5 clause 'wired into qa_report' reads qa_report.mjs as text and runs a regex for the literal line `for (const d of deckTypeAudit(deck)) findings.push({ stage: "deck-type", ...d })`. A mutant that keeps the text but disables it still passes. Examples: `if (false) for (...)`, moving the line after an early return, or putting it inside a comment block that a reformat leaves on one line. A refactor that keeps the behaviour but changes the text, such as `findings.push(...deckTypeAudit(deck).map(...))`, fails the test. The regex therefore gives false negatives and false positives for the behaviour it claims to prove.
findings.why_vulnerable: qaReport() is never called with a deck in this test file, so nothing shows that a deck-type finding reaches the returned findings array or the printed report or exit code. qaReport needs deck.html and Playwright (verifySlides), which is probably why the author avoided a behavioural test.
findings.how_to_confirm: Apply mutation target 15 (prefix scholar-slides/scripts/qa_report.mjs L59 with `if (false) `), then run `node --test tests/deck_type.test.mjs`. All tests stay green.
findings.recommendation: Test the behaviour instead. One option: split the deck.json-only part of qaReport into an exported pure function, e.g. deckFindings(deck, sourceText), and assert that a deck with deck_type 'poster' produces a finding with stage 'deck-type' and check 'unknown-deck-type'. The other option: call qaReport on a tiny fixture directory with verifySlides stubbed out.

findings.title: Defense title vocabulary: untested alternatives and false negatives on common motivation-slide titles
findings.what_goes_wrong: LIMITS_RE is matched against every slide title. It matches 'Limitations of existing methods' and '现有方法的不足', which are the most common motivation-slide titles in English and Chinese theses (checked with node: both return true). A defense deck with no slide on its own limitations or future work therefore passes the P2 missing-limitations check, which is a realistic false negative. BACKUP_RE also matches the ordinary words 备份 and 'backup' in section titles such as '数据备份机制设计' or 'Backup and recovery in LSM stores'. A main-body section divider with such a title satisfies the Backup requirement whenever any slide follows it. The 'followed by at least one slide' condition is also met by a trailing 'Thank you / Q&A' slide or another section divider. In the tests, the single conforming title 'Limitations and future work' contains both phrases, and no test has a non-section slide titled Backup. Mutants that delete either LIMITS_RE alternative, or the `s.layout === "section"` guard, therefore survive (targets 7 and 10).
findings.why_vulnerable: The checks are bag-of-words regexes over titles, with no position constraint (for example, the limitations slide must come after the results or near the end) and no exclusion of phrases about prior work ('of existing/prior', '现有/已有…的不足').
findings.how_to_confirm: Inference from the code plus a regex check, not run against project code. Build a defense deck whose only matching title is '现有方法的不足' and that has a Backup divider plus one slide. deckTypeAudit returns []. Apply target 7 or target 10 (single alternative). deck_type.test.mjs stays green.
findings.recommendation: Exclude prior-work phrasings from LIMITS_RE, or require the matching slide to come after the first results-type slide. Drop 不足 and 备份 or anchor them more tightly. Require the slide after the Backup divider to be a non-section content slide. Add tests for: a 'Limitations'-only title, a 'Future work'-only title, a bullets slide titled 'Backup' (must still give P2), and a motivation slide titled '现有方法的不足' with no other match (must give P2).

limits: snapshot-only; no command reproduction; no OS sandbox; reviewer: claude subagent (same model family as author). Read with git show at the pinned head only. Mutant outcomes are predicted from the test source, not executed. Only the node regex behaviour on the copied BACKUP_RE/LIMITS_RE literals was checked. evidence/MANIFEST hashes were not verified because no evidence files are cited. Corpus impact comes from reading deck.json slide layouts and titles, not from running qa_report.
